• Submit data from the bottom of the "Current Delivery" with the red square & up arrow button.
  • If there are errors, you will be directed to these. You may not submit until the data is collected.
  • If there are no errors, you will certify and submit
  • Once submitted, you will get a pop-up confirming your submission. You will see the submission under "Completed Deliveries", and you will be emailed a PDF copy of your submitted logbook.
