• Once you complete a trip, select "Delivery" from the main menu to add fish tickets and other final data.
    • Many fields will be saved for future landings so you do not need to always re-enter
    • For fish tickets, use the red plus button to add one or more tickets
    • Review the "Sets Included in the Delivery". All completed sets will be automatically added to this list, but you can review and either add/remove sets
