Daily Fishing Log

  • From the home screen add a new record for each date of fishing, or select an existing date to edit:
  • For each date, fill out your activity and catch. A location is required only if you were setting gear (even if there was no catch)
  • Record all catch that are kept or released. Fish counts are required but average weights are optional.
  • The catch screen will give you an option to choose the species from a drop-down list or add favorite species so that they will be on the shortcut list.

Delivery - Trip Information

  • From the home screen, enter your departure date and port. For all other trip info, select the "Delivery" button at the bottom of the home screen.
  • The "HMS Current Delivery" screen is a place to enter your return date and time, port, and vessel information. Also enter unloading (fish ticket) information.
